book.name: iJɔn
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iJɔn

content: IYesu tsetu engwafɔ egyafa.
Ngwi ungwɔnɛ wa nyɛ nɛ, iYesu di tsetu emi ongwafɔɔn, mi ekyoo okwukwo mgbi iTiberia. Li itɔ ofɛ ngwi i kyɔ joani:
iSaimɔn iPyita, iTɔmɔsu (ngwi a li kwun di ongwefa nani) iNataniɛ ongwi iKana mi ɛsɛ iGalalia, emi ongwɛ iDzebedi, bɛyi engwafɔ mgbi iYesu angbeka efa kpaa to mbonyi.
ISaimɔn iPyita nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Ani le lu mtsɛ ota-ta,>> a gbɛɛ, <<Eyi kpaa ka kɛ yi abu.>> Ta a si tasɛ ka kaka uwaa, kpaa mi otu na duu a kwu unkonyi ba.
Mi egbegbe ototu nɛ iYesu wa kwudzɛkɛ mi agobo, kpaa emi engwafɔɔn yagba difwi gbɛɛ li iYesu ba.
O kwu ma ela kɛ gbɛɛ, <<Emi okani, ema kwu nka wa lo?>> A nun uka gbɛɛ, <<Ei.>>
O nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Ngwi Ibriji mgbi ema mi abugye mgbi uwaa ta ema ka kwu ungwɔ.>> Ngwi a kyɔ ngha nɛta, a yagba okwo ukɛ kaka uwaa ba, ikye mmbweni kwuba ngwi a kwu mani.

Ta ongwafɔ nkpa iYesu itukwu na nya iPyita gbɛɛ, <<Li Otsɛ iYesu!>> Ngwi iSaimɔn iPyita fwo gbɛɛ, <<Li Otsɛ nɛ,>> o kye angwuto mgban ongwi esɛ tukwu (lubana o teyi kye kwulu mi ewo) man ngwa gyɛkɛ eni.
Engwafɔ angbeka ntona kyɛdɔ mi uwaa, a kwo ukɛ yi mmbwɛ ngwi mbweele ma luba agobo, ikyesinɛ i tunto yi agobo ba, i mɛ dafi akwubɔ ideli onyi hini.
Ngwi a tɔ lu agobo nɛ, a di ibredi ladzɛ, angola le gbɛ mmbweni di dɔdzɛ ele.
IYesu nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Dulu mmbwɛ ngwi ema kwa kwu nɛ ba na.>>
ISaimɔn iPyita tɔdɔkɛ uwaa di kye kwolu ukɛ dɔkɛ esɛ. Mmbweni okwukwo mbweele, duu li ideli onyi yi ngwusefa dɔn iwyo diwyeta, ma dafi mmbwɛ ntona le kwuba nɛ kpaa ukɛ fawa ba.
IYesu nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Ba wa tiikyɛ na.>> Onyi mi ifu ma kpaa shitukwu byun ita gbɛɛ, <<Abu li emɛ ba>> A ye dafi li Otsɛ iYesu mani.
IYesu wa kyelu ibredi ma kye nu ma, di kyɔ ngha yɛyɛ yi mmbweni ma kpaa
Nɛnɛ li akpe ongwu ta ngwi iYesu mblegba tu emi ongwafɔɔn mi onɔ ngwi o kyɛ mi ikwu aani.
IYesu yile iPyita dzɛ ofɛ

Onɔ ngwi a gye ungwogye ngyɛ nɛ, iYesu byi iSaimɔn iPyita ita gbɛɛ, <<iSaimɔn ongwɛ iJɔn, otsitsi-otsitsi ani kpa abu itukwu ngha ungwɔ ntonɛɛ?>> O gbɛɛ, <<Ɛɛn, Otsɛ, abu ye dafi abu kpa ani itukwu mani.>> IYesu nyan gbɛɛ, <<Byi mmala mgbi ani enbwa.>>
IYesu di byun gbɛɛ, <<ISaimɔn ongwɛ iJɔn, ani kpa abu itukwu otsitsii?>> O nu uka gbɛɛ, <<Ɛɛn, Otsɛ iYesu, abu ye dafi abu kpa ani itukwu mani.>> IYesu nyan gbɛɛ, <<Gbɛwɛbyi mmala mgbi ani.>>

Akpe ongwu ta o byin gbɛɛ, <<iSaimɔn ongwɛ iJɔn, ani kpa abu itukwuu?>> IPyita wulu itukwu ikyesinɛ iYesu byun akpe ongwu ta gbɛɛ, <<Ani kpa abu itukwuu?>> O gbɛɛ, <<Otsɛ, abu ye alungwɔ duu; abu ye gbɛɛ abu kpa ani itukwu.>> IYesu nyan gbɛɛ, <<Byi mmala mgbi ani enbwa.

N nya abu otsitsi, onɔ ngwi abu li mmafa ma, o li gbe angwuto wo ewo di kɛ imbe ngwi abu mina duu, kpaa onɔ ngwi abu yɛɛ ishongye abu ka na abɔ mgbi abu efa, inggisɛ oka ka gbe angwuto wo abu di kye abu kɛ imbe nmina abu okɛɛkɛ ba mani.>>
IYesu gbɔ ungwɔnɛ ikye otso itɔ ikwu mgbi iPyita ngwi o ka wa kwu kye okwɔkwɔ nu Imgbasho mani. Ta o nyan gbɛɛ, <<Kyɛdɔ ani!>>

IPyita kyata inɛ man di ongwafɔ nkpa iYesu itukwu na kyɛ ma iyikpa. (Li ongwu nsɔ kye ewo ge iYesu mi onɔ ngwi a le gye ungwogye ongwi olɛlɛ di li ongwu teyi byi iYesu gbɛɛ, <<Otsɛ, li emɛ ka kye abu gya?>>)
Onɔ ngwi iPyita din nɛ, o byi iYesu gbɛɛ, <<Otsɛ, li ekyɛ ngwi inggisɛ nɛ ka kyɔ?>>
IYesu nu uka gbɛɛ, <<kini ani mina gbɛɛ no dzɛ oshishe nghataa ni ani wa yɛ ba ma, li ekyɛ mgbi ema mi ele? Abu yɔ kyɛdɔ ani.>>

Mi ikye odzɛ nɛ, ayayi odzɛ gbɔfwɛ mbi emi ongwunɔn gbɛɛ ongwafɔ nɛ ka kwulu ba. Nghaduu iYesu gbɛɛ o ka kwulu ba ba, o gbɔɔgbɔ ta gbɛɛ, <<Kini ani mina gbɛɛ non dzɛ oshishe nghataa ni ani wa yɛ ma, li ekyɛ mgbi ema mi ele?>>
Nɛnɛ li ongwafɔ nkyɔ obwɛndɛ mi ungwɔ ntonɛ duu di lɔ ma tokɛ esɛ. Eyi ye dafi obwɛndɛ mgban li otsitsi mani.
IYesu kyungwɔ angbeka kpaa kwuba. Ni a ki lɔ alungwɔ duu tokɛ esɛ yɔ, n tsɛwɛ gbɛɛ ɛsɛ duu kpaa imbe kika dzɛ ogbe afɛ ntona tokɛ ba.
